authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Current Planning Data Local authority district dataset contains ONS-provided administrative boundaries of local authorities in England (344 records at review time). Up to 50 records were considered as the bounded source window. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LAD identifier/name, LPA reference/name, organisation code, local-plan/local-plan-boundary reference, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Therefore none of these official LAD polygons can be bound to this slot without guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no source-area geometry is emitted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
